items.quote: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them
items.claim: The sons of the dead patriarch followed his burial instructions. The text only says 'him'. Identifying him as Jacob/Israel comes from the surrounding chapter of Genesis 50 and is an unverified model-prior, not something in this excerpt.
items.mechanism: a dying father's command obeyed by his sons

items.quote: For his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah
items.claim: The sons carried their father's body into Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah.
items.place: cave of the field of Machpelah, land of Canaan, before Mamre
items.mechanism: moving the body to be buried in the family's burial place

items.quote: which Abraham bought with the field for a possession of a buryingplace of Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre
items.claim: Abraham had earlier bought the field and cave of Machpelah, near Mamre, from Ephron the Hittite to own as a burial place.
items.object: the field and cave of Machpelah as a buryingplace
items.mechanism: buying land to own as a family burial place
